reasons: All four preferred atomic elements (12-month automatic terms, 30-day Customer opt-out, 60-day Vendor reminder, lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap) are present in operative text, so the locked preferred level is complete.

The official minimality gate flags a 19→89 word expansion, but the original sentence contained none of the reminder or price-cap mechanics, so a concise insertion of the missing elements was unavoidable; every inserted phrase maps to a required preferred element and no broad new exception, boilerplate, or other-level term was added.

Untouched terms (36-month Initial Period, Licensor termination for breach, retained payment rights, paragraphs II and III) remain effective; note the residual pre-existing tension between automatic renewal and the paragraphs II/III mutual-written-extension language, which existed before the edit (the deleted sentence already gave Licensor a unilateral renewal option) and is worth aligning in a follow-up.
The official check reporting the non-renewal window number 'not found' is a pattern artefact; the clause expressly states a 30-day Licensee non-renewal notice.
